headline.size_rel: small, ~0.03h, single line in a white speech-bubble at top

layout.host_pos: full-bleed vertical face-cam, seated, chest-up, centered slightly left
layout.safe_zones: top 8% reserved for title bubble; bottom 10% reserved for caption pill; sides ~4% margin
layout.caption_pos: bottom-third, overlapping chin/chest, small pill/box per word-burst

transitions: none — single continuous static talking-head shot, no cuts/b-roll for whole 97s

themeable: accent (caption pill color) can be swapped per channel brand
background (host's room) is fixed/non-themeable unless re-shot
